profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer @ Databricks | ex-Tecton (Acquired), Google
profile.summary:
I specialize in building platforms that empower engineers to move faster. What I bring to the table:

- Scale: Technical leadership on teams at the forefront of planet-scale engineering (Google, Databricks).
- Efficiency: A track record of radical optimization. I’ve led initiatives that slashed environment setup times by 90%+, raised stability of validation infrastructure by 6x+, reduced 7-figure cloud spend by 18%, and optimized build systems to reduce memory overhead by 80%.
- Well-Rounded Leadership: A hybrid background as a Principal IC and Engineering Manager / Manager-of-Managers. I’ve led teams at startups (Tecton), high-growth scale-ups (Toast), and global tech leaders (Google, Databricks). I can diagnose a technical domain, devise a technical strategy, drive alignment from engineering teams up through executives, and drive execution through landed impact.

I’m at my best when I’m designing high-level architecture, mentoring senior talent, and building platforms that "just work."

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am a technical lead in Databricks' Service Abstractions organization, with two primary foci:

* [Deep] A novel first-party durable workflow engine built on top of Databricks' storage and routing infrastructure. This framework provides a resilient foundation for long-running, stateful service interactions across Databricks.
* [Broad] Simple, agentic microservice authoring - abstracting the complexity of service creation to enable engineering teams to deploy production-ready microservices that automatically adhere to Databricks’ best practices for security, observability, and scalability.

positions.title: Senior Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led Tecton's Platforms organization—encompassing Developer Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, and Application Platforms—through its acquisition by Databricks.

* Core Frameworks: Designed new Workflow Orchestration primitives to accelerate development velocity on Tecton’s most critical product functionality. 
* Infrastructure Cost Optimization: Reduced annual AWS spend by 18% (7-figure savings) through infrastructure right-sizing and architectural improvements.
* Test Infrastructure & Observability: Built a centralized metrics pipeline and automated reporting suite to provide granular visibility into test stability. By surfacing actionable data to individual teams (as well as driving central improvements), median release freshness improved by 60% and PR-blocking test speeds improved by 50%.
* Build Systems: Optimized Bazel persistent worker fanout for large local builds, reducing memory usage by over 80%.
* Security & Compliance: Partnered with Security to establish Tecton's first CVE policy, remediating several hundred critical vulnerabilities and implementing automated dependency upgrade workflows.
* Organizational Leadership: Bootstrapped the "Foundations" engineering team and served as skip-level manager for the DevOps organization.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer and Engineering Manager for the Developer Platform organization.  Responsible for technical strategy and the direct management of 11 engineers (Junior to Staff level).

* Architecture: Developed a hybridized iterative development model using Envoy and Pulsar for dynamic request diversion, reducing environment setup time from 16 minutes to 1 minute.
* Infrastructure Reliability: Improved E2E test pass rates from 13% to 85% through framework enhancements and infrastructure stabilizing projects.
* Data Pipelines: Built metrics pipelines that aggregated engineering productivity and security data for executive-level reviews.
* Team Leadership: Received a 100% "would recommend" rating from direct reports in 360 reviews, with specific recognition for technical mentorship and design review contributions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed and TL’d 12 engineers across Search Serving Infrastructure. My work focused on webserver frameworks, monolith decomposition, and developer velocity for one of the world's most complex distributed systems.

* Architectural Transformation: Created Java code portability patterns that enabled the first-ever microservice extraction from Google's 20+ year-old Search monolith without requiring business logic rewrites.
* Developer Velocity: Reduced engineer dissatisfaction with the Google Webserver (GWS) development process by 81%, impacting 1000+ engineers. Designed core tech that cut cold build/startup times by 95% and hot-reload by 66%. 
* Reliability & Efficiency: Led a cross-org initiative to raise Quality Evaluation environment reliability from 14% to 90%. This resulted in 2x latency improvements, a 5x error reduction, and saved the equivalent of 12 SWE-years in machine resources.
* People Leadership: Managed 12 SWEs (Junior to Staff). Maintained a 91% People Manager Review score and successfully facilitated three promotions.
